:::{#rem-ones-vector-sum}
#### The ones vector sums the entries

The dot product (@def-dot-product) of $\v1$ with $\vx$
is the sum of the entries of $\vx$:
$\v1 \cdot \vx = \sumip 1 \cd x_i = \sumip x_i$.
For example, for $\vx = (2, -1, 5)$,
$\v1 \cdot \vx = 2 + (-1) + 5 = 6$,
and dividing by the length $p = 3$ gives the mean of the entries, $6 / 3 = 2$.

:::
